name: 코코파스
wear: Volcanic rock becomes slate-gray faceted armor; the red triangular compass nose becomes a broad triangular breastplate inlay, compass needles become short collar motifs, and circular holes become recessed round armor vents.
scene: A windswept volcanic plateau with upright basalt pillars and floating iron-sand arcs.

casual_plan.scene: Sunlight falls across a stone-topped appraisal counter; the vintage ball and travel compass lie side by side as she examines their joins through a small loupe.
casual_plan.outfit: A charcoal sleeveless cropped utility vest over a secure rust-red bandeau and a wrap mini skirt, exposing shoulders, waist and legs; angular pockets echo basalt facets.
casual_plan.exampleText: Pokémon artifact appraiser examining a vintage Poké Ball and travel tools with a jeweler's loupe at a display table.

axis_reasons.source_influence: surveyor_cartographer: Angular basalt pockets carry the source geometry.
axis_reasons.action_level: auction_specialist: examining small objects through a loupe involves restrained hand movement.
axis_reasons.separates_preference: surveyor_cartographer: The selected garment construction is vest, skirt.
